doc.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007

title: Preparing The Sound of Jazz
summary: He spends about four hours preparing each show and likes being well prepared.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: He sure was. Yeah, I know you mentioned that the other day on your show that you played something by him that wasn’t out, hadn’t been reissued yet. Do you — let’s talk about “The Sound of Jazz” for a bit. Do you listen first to everything you play?
Yeah I take about four hours to do a show. But it’s a joy, I love it.
Yeah, it’s not like a chore.
